2607.02245.title: Copewell: A Multi-Agent Swarm Architecture for Equitable Mental Wellness Support
2607.02245.paper_summary: Mental health disorders affect nearly one billion people globally, yet 75% of individuals in low- and middle-income countries receive no treatment due to workforce shortages, cost barriers, and stigma. Current AI-powered wellness solutions predominantly rely on single-mode conversational interfaces that suffer high abandonment rates and fail to provide measurable, immediate relief calibrated to users' dynamic emotional states. This paper presents Copewell, a novel multi-agent swarm system designed to expand access to mental wellness support through human-centered AI principles. Our architecture introduces three technical innovations: (1) a multi-source assessment framework integrating self-reported, physiological, and contextual data to mitigate algorithmic bias; (2) valence-arousal emotion mapping using Russell's Circumplex Model of Affect to route users to specialized AI agents; and (3) dual-mode intervention delivery combining conversational support with evidence-based sensory wellness protocols. We examine the sociotechnical design considerations underlying Copewell's development, including a privacy-first architecture, embedded ethical oversight through a dedicated Ethics Supervisor agent, and participatory design informed by mental health practitioners. Early practitioner engagement and beta deployment inform design decisions and identify directions for future empirical evaluation. This work contributes to responsible AI discourse by demonstrating how technical architecture can operationalize equity and safety principles from inception.
2607.02245.paper_summary_zh: 心理健康障礙影響全球近十億人，然而在低收入和中等收入國家，75%的人未接受任何治療，原因包括人力資源短缺、成本障礙和污名化。當前的人工智慧驅動健康解決方案主要依賴單一模式的對話介面，這些介面面臨高放棄率，無法提供根據用戶動態情緒狀態調整的可衡量、即時的緩解。本文介紹了Copewell，一個新穎的多代理群體系統，旨在通過以人為本的人工智慧原則擴大心理健康支持的可及性。我們的架構引入了三項技術創新：（1）多來源評估框架，整合自我報告、生理和情境數據，以減少算法偏見；（2）使用羅素的情感圓環模型進行情緒的價值-喚起映射，以引導用戶到專門的人工智慧代理；（3）雙模式介入交付，結合對話支持和基於證據的感官健康協議。我們考察了支持Copewell開發的社會技術設計考量，包括隱私優先的架構、通過專門的倫理監督代理嵌入的倫理監督，以及受到心理健康從業者啟發的參與式設計。早期從業者的參與和測試部署為設計決策提供了信息，並確定了未來實證評估的方向。這項工作通過展示技術架構如何從一開始就實現公平和安全原則，為負責任的人工智慧討論作出了貢獻。
